root_cause.text: dwc2_hsotg_udc_stop() calls dwc2_gadget_exit_clock_gating() without holding hsotg->lock, violating the locking requirement of the call_gadget() macro used internally, leading to a spin_unlock on an unlocked lock and a later deadlock.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message and CVE description explicitly state that dwc2_gadget_exit_clock_gating() internally uses the call_gadget() macro which expects hsotg->lock to be held (as it does spin_unlock/spin_lock around the callback), but dwc2_hsotg_udc_stop() calls it without holding the lock. The patch adds spin_lock_irqsave(&hsotg->lock, flags) before the call and spin_unlock_irqrestore(&hsotg->lock, flags) after.

intent_record.intent_summary: Add proper locking around dwc2_gadget_exit_clock_gating call in dwc2_hsotg_udc_stop to prevent concurrent access to shared state.
intent_record.what: Added spin_lock_irqsave and spin_unlock_irqrestore around the call to dwc2_gadget_exit_clock_gating in dwc2_hsotg_udc_stop.
intent_record.how: The change ensures mutual exclusion by acquiring the spinlock hsotg->lock with interrupts disabled before calling dwc2_gadget_exit_clock_gating, and releasing it afterwards, preventing potential race conditions on shared state.
